title: Reading Drill — Photographs of a Changing Square
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Photographs of a Changing Square
passages.body:
**A** A local history group collected snapshots of a town square from family albums. Photographs without dates were compared with an old shop directory, which listed when each business occupied a property.

**B** The directory was useful but sometimes slow to reflect a change. A sign might stay above an empty shop for months, so researchers also looked for building work visible in the photographs.

**C** Each final caption gave a range of possible years when needed. The group invited contributions during the exhibition and used a removable label when new evidence meant a range needed to be revised.
